business_problem: Allstate wanted to understand complex customer touchpoints well enough to resolve issues before satisfaction dropped, but privacy requirements, IT governance, and long customer-engagement cycles made it hard to deploy and refine new AI capabilities quickly inside production systems.
solution_summary: Allstate worked with BCG X to extend its customer-experience models with GenAI and predictive machine learning so service teams could identify at-risk journeys before issues escalated. Using ChatGPT and other GenAI functionality, the joint team added an interpretation layer to Allstate's models and customer intelligence to detect nuanced behaviors and complex signals across customer touchpoints. BCG processed customer transcripts as connected inputs, measured signal changes over time, and combined those GenAI-derived insights with more than 200 personalized customer-specific features already in place. Those inputs fed a predictive ML model that flagged elevated-servicing needs and alerted the right representatives. The model ran against existing subsystems without requiring system changes, and IT, technology, data operations, strategy, and risk teams governed the rollout under Allstate's responsible-AI standards. BCG and Allstate stood up the working model in four weeks.

data_flow: Customer touchpoint data, existing model outputs, and interaction transcripts are processed with GenAI features and time-based signal analysis. Those insights are combined with more than 200 personalized customer-specific features in a predictive ML model that scores journeys, identifies customers needing extra support, and sends alerts to service representatives while running against existing subsystems.
business_outcome: Allstate gained a working GenAI-assisted predictive service model that helps teams intervene earlier in customer journeys, improve satisfaction, and create reusable AI building blocks that can be scaled across additional business verticals under responsible-AI governance.
